decision.explanation: Document d01 explicitly states that the South Calgary provincial electoral district was created in 1913 when the Calgary district was divided into three ridings. Other dates refer to different electoral districts (e.g., Calgary-Southeast at the federal level) or different scopes (e.g., re-creation in 2010).
